model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port :in Event :as keep) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port :out Snapshot :as metric) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (block RetryRenderer :type "Service"
      (port :in Receipt :as req)
      (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
    (adjacent
      (block LiveAuth :type "Service"
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
      (block EdgeUploader :type "Store"
        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
        (level
          (block Renderer
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))))
    (adjacent
      (block RetryLedger
        (port :in Event)
        (port :out Request :as done)
        (implements Observable)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Parser :type "Store"
        (port :in Command)
        (port :out Request :as done)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Router
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
    (block Planner
      (port :in Request :as evt)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
      (level
        (adjacent
          (block RemoteMetrics
            (port :in Receipt :as evt)
            (port :out Receipt :as emit)
            (implements Observable)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block Uploader :type "Process"
            (port :in Receipt :as evt)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block EdgeCatalog
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
          (block LiveQueue :type "Store"
            (port :in Snapshot :as req)
            (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
        (adjacent
          (block BatchCatalog
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
          (block ShadowMetrics :type "Process"
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block BatchScheduler
                  (port :in Receipt :as req)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block EdgeSearch
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
            (level
              (block Cache :type "Feature"
                (port :in Event :as req)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
          (block LiveBilling :type "Process"
            (port :in Receipt)
            (port :out Event :as done)
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
          (block RetryFeed
            (port :in Command :as evt)
            (port :out Receipt)
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block Queue
                  (port :in Snapshot :as evt)
                  (port :out Receipt :as done)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block RemoteSearch
                  (port :in Snapshot :as req)
                  (port :out Receipt)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block Pricing :type "Service"
                  (port :in Snapshot :as evt)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block LiveScheduler
                  (port :in Command :as req)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                (block EdgeSync
                  (port :in Command :as evt)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block Ledger
                  (port :in Event :as req)
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                (block Scheduler
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
              (adjacent
                (block Search
                  (port :out Event :as emit)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block LocalMailer
                  (port :in Request :as evt)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))))
      (level
        (block Inbox
          (port :in Snapshot)
          (port :out Command)
          (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
        (block RetryInbox
          (port :in Command)
          (port :out Event)
          (implements Observable)
          (sketch "Thin wrapper.")
          (level
            (adjacent
              (block RetryBilling :type "Store"
                (port :in Event)
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
              (block LocalPlanner
                (port :in Receipt :as evt)
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
            (adjacent
              (block RetryCatalog :type "Feature"
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
              (block ShadowFeed :type "Feature"
                (port :in Receipt)
                (port :out Command)
                (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))
        (adjacent
          (block LocalCache
            (implements Observable)
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
          (block ShadowScheduler :type "Feature"
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
            (level
              (block Index
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))))))))
  (level
    (block EdgePlanner
      (port :in Command)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
